definitions.explanation: Having a lot to do; occupied with tasks.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{忙|いそが}しいです。
{忙|いそが}しくて{時間|じかん}がありません。
examples.english: I'm too busy and don't have time.

examples.japanese: お{忙|いそが}しいところすみません。
examples.english: Sorry to bother you when you're busy.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}{仕事|しごと}が{忙|いそが}しくて、{友達|ともだち}に{会|あ}う{時間|じかん}がありません。
examples.english: Work has been busy lately, so I don't have time to see my friends.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}は{忙|いそが}しいですが、{再来週|さらいしゅう}は{暇|ひま}です。いつがいいですか。
examples.english: Next week I'm busy, but the week after I'm free. When would be good for you?

notes: Antonym: {暇|ひま} (free, not busy). Common complaint in Japanese work culture.
